t0016-01.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
t0016-01.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.

t0016-02.gloss: Field stock travelled together with a trace on one seam.
t0016-02.rival_reading: Emergency crews could move farm supplies in a van during a road closure; a stain and clean label do not establish a failed agricultural program.
